create_braess_network: create a Braess network graph with configurable road capacity for routing game experiments
create_augmented_braess_network: create an augmented Braess network graph with an extra road segment for routing game experiments
create_series_parallel_network: create a series-parallel network graph with configurable depth and capacity for routing game experiments
create_games: create dynamic routing game instances including turn-based and mean-field variants from a graph and vehicle configuration
counterfactual_regret_minimization: run counterfactual regret minimization algorithm to compute approximate Nash equilibrium for a routing game
